inputs.objective: Locate observation, geometry, fit and ground-transform contributions before any method changes
inputs.controls: Frozen current input, calibration, masks, body parameters and archived baseline scene; no inference/refit/replay
inputs.diagnostic_variable: Algebraic removal of ground transform; isolated within-valid-triple kernel as explicit counterfactual only
inputs.success: Recomputed raw XYZ/mask/quality match saved body; exact world-step decomposition and same-frame residual invariance; visual audit of preset and ranked frames
inputs.stop: Frame/mask/source mismatch, non-rigid scene, unavailable images; preserve failures and do not substitute
inputs.units: 2D px; 3D mm; indexed step mm/frame and second difference mm/frame^2, not physical acceleration
inputs.limits: No anatomical 3D or stage truth; motion includes actual movement; pose component is an algebraic term, not a percentage of error
inputs.scene_usage: Saved scene is an audited input, not a newly replayed scene or new 3D visualization
inputs.visual_selection: Preset 0,42,74,101,136,139,184,226,268,313,359 plus maximum arm residual, raw knee second difference, model pelvis-relative knee second difference, and five largest world pose steps; include ranked-event neighbours
inputs.visual_supplement: contact_sheet from same module, existing overlays, 201/202/203; camera-space original-image comparison only

scope: Frozen historical audit only; no new inference, fitting, triangulation or stage replay
success: Exact source/ID alignment and unchanged ground R/t, zero pose term, visual legibility
limits: Real movement included; no anatomical truth; arrows compare displacement vectors from their own starting positions
